correctness.rationale: The adjoint monomial action gives oriented edges nk→mk and the constant summand [2]. To check completeness independently, put m=ga, n=gb, with a,b coprime. Outside the multiples of g the positive-degree vertices are isolated. On multiples of g divide the index by g. If a,b>1, each reduced positive index has a unique form a^p b^q u with a∤u, b∤u, using maximal integer-power exponents. The edges increase p and decrease q, keeping u and p+q fixed, so the full components are paths of size p+q+1, of each size countably many. If one reduced degree is 1, the same argument with maximal powers of the other degree gives rays (up to reversal); positive indices outside multiples of the smaller original degree are infinite isolated zeros. Discrete sine vectors diagonalize finite paths, and the half-line sine transform makes a ray multiplication by 2 cos θ on (0,π); its spectral measures are absolutely continuous and it has no eigenvalues. Both ordinary spectra fill [−2,2], with no isolated points, so the Fredholm essential spectra are the whole interval. In both cases 2 is a simple eigenvalue and −2 is not an eigenvalue; the dense atoms in the nondivisible case do not make every spectral point an eigenvalue.
residual_risks: The recorded finite graph truncations cannot decide infinite spectral type. The proof, rather than those diagnostics, establishes the spectral claims for the prescribed monomial symbols.

In the divisible case g is the smaller original degree and is at least 2, so dilation adds infinitely many zeros. In the nondivisible case zero blocks are already countably infinite at ℓ=1, and extra zeros are absorbed there.
Standard sine diagonalizations turn these models into exactly the asserted atomic and absolutely continuous laws. Completeness and density force both essential intervals.

evidence: For g=gcd(m,n), write m=ga, n=gb. On e_k, U_n*U_m sends k to ak/b if b divides k, and is zero otherwise. U_mU_n* acting on e_{gk} sends gk to gak/b under the same condition and is zero otherwise. The isometry e_k↦e_{gk} therefore transports one product to the reducing range for the other; the orthogonal complement is zero.

originality.rationale: The entire frozen classification follows directly from the pre-existing published unitary classification of the reverse product U_n*U_m in Resultary 71d831748432. The different order of factors is not a substantive difference: dilation identifies U_n*U_m unitarily with the restriction of U_mU_n* to indices divisible by gcd(m,n), and the complement is zero. Symmetrizing the classified blocks and applying the standard sine spectra yields the full frozen claim. A separate later indexed classification e66a895c9359 directly treats U_mU_n* and supplies a second route to the same result; its date is not evidence of earlier priority.
residual_risks: The inspected literature does not establish exhaustive historical priority. The failure here rests on a specific verified prior implication, not on a catalog miss or speculation about other sources.
